entities.summary: Wat Banan is the best-preserved of the Khmer temples in Battambang Province. The distinctive five towers of the temple are similar to the much larger and more famous temple of Angkor Wat. At the base of the mountain, is a step laterite staircase flanked by nagas. Wat Banan is a archaeological site from Asia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
